body.name: Wholly untrusted refinement
body.construction: A surjection \(g:\widetilde{\mathcal E}\to\mathcal E\) is wholly untrusted when every \(x\in T\) has a unique preimage in \(\widetilde T\), no element of \(g^{-1}(U)\) belongs to \(\widetilde T\), and \(\widetilde p\) pushes forward to \(p\) arm by arm.
